newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean stock body approves nine IPOs - official.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean stock body approves nine IPOs - official.

text.p: South Korea's Stock Supervisory Board (SSB) has approved applications for nine initial public offerings (IPO), an SSB official said on Friday.
However, the SSB denied an application by equipment maker Hankook Steel Co Ltd. The company did not meet the necessary criteria, said Byun Won-ho, an SSB official. He did not give further details.

Accepted for public offering were: Hyundai Electronics Industrial Co's offering of 10 million shares at 20,000 won, Samsung Engineering Co's 1.86 million shares at 23,000 and Kukdong City Gas Co's 1.8 million shares at 22,000 won.

Hyundai Electronics Industrial Co is a unit of Hyundai Group and Samsung Engineering Co a unit of Samsung Group. Textile wholesaler Kuk Dong Corp will also offer 337,500 shares at 16,000; chemical products producer Sewon Chemical Co, around 442,000 shares at 18,000 won; distiller Muhak Alcohol Co, 260,000 shares at 14,000; chemical products producer Dong Nam Chemical Industries Co 280,000 shares at 15,000; office machinery maker Sindoricoh Co 2.88 million shares at 39,000; and furniture maker Fursys Inc 920,000 at 35,000 won.
The offerings will be held on November 19 and 20, and the shares will begin publicly trading in January.
Byun said the application of First Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd was postponed and will be considered again next month. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5644
